title: LIMIT
explain: LIMIT caps how many rows come back, and `OFFSET` skips some first. Together with ORDER BY they give you top-N lists and pages. Without ORDER BY you only get an arbitrary few rows.
exercise: Show the single lowest score, then show page 2 of the list with 2 students per page.
tip: Large OFFSET values get slow on big tables. For deep pages, filter on the last value you saw instead.
